d: Nvidia’s former CEO Jensen Huang’s alleged infidelity has sparked a wider debate about power, fame and relationships. But why do some successful people seek validation outside their relationships? Psychological research suggests that infidelity can stem from several factors, including ego, insecurity, the desire for new experiences and opportunities. Studies have also explored the connection between power, confidence and the likelihood of cheating. In this explainer, we look beyond the headlines to understand the psychology behind infidelity and whether power can influence human behaviour.
